params.name: id
params.description: Surf fund UUID. PREFERRED — always use this when available from a previous response (e.g. id from /search/fund). Takes priority over q.

params.name: q
params.description: Fuzzy fund name search. Only use when 'id' is not available. May return unexpected results for ambiguous names.

items.docs:
Returns a crypto VC fund's full profile: description, jurisdiction, portfolio count, social links, and team members with roles.

**Included fields:** X accounts, team members, recent research, invested project count.

This does NOT return the list of investments — use `/fund/portfolio` for that.

**Lookup:** by UUID (`id`) or name (`q`). Returns 404 if not found.

params.name: is_lead
params.description: Filter by lead investor status. Omit or leave empty for all investments.

params.name: invested_after
params.description: Only include investments at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds)

params.name: invested_before
params.description: Only include investments before this Unix timestamp (seconds)

items.docs:
Returns investment rounds for a fund's portfolio, sorted by date (newest first).

A project may appear multiple times if the fund participated in multiple rounds.

**Included fields:** project name, logo, date, raise amount, lead investor status.

**Lookup:** by UUID (`id`) or name (`q`).

params.name: metric
params.description: Ranking metric. Can be `tier` (lower is better) or `portfolio_count` (number of invested projects).

items.docs:
Returns top crypto VC funds ranked by tier or portfolio count.

**Available metrics:** `tier` (lower is better), `portfolio_count` (number of invested projects).
